name: xyz.quantumatlas/ucp-shopping-hub
title: Quantum Atlas Universal Commerce Storefront (UCP)
description: UCP 2026-08-25 MCP storefront: 37 x402 APIs, Stripe SPT & $1-$100 packs, carts & order tracking.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description:
Search Quantum Atlas UCP products including Stripe X402 prepaid spend packs and live 50/50 Base ERC-1155 collaboration drops. Use this first for keyword discovery; do not use for batch ID refresh (lookup_catalog) or single-item PDP detail (get_product).
Parameters: pass catalog.query, optional catalog.filters (available, price.min/max in cents, category), catalog.context, and catalog.pagination (limit 1-50, cursor).
Behavior: read-only, zero auth, zero charge; returns minor-unit USD prices, variant IDs, and pagination.

profile.description: Public HTTPS URL of the calling buying-agent UCP profile document.

idempotency-key.description: UUIDv4 or client token guaranteeing replay-safe mutations across retries.

meta.description: UCP protocol request metadata (meta.ucp-agent and meta.idempotency-key).

query.description: Free-text product search query (e.g. "spend key", "50/50", "music", "credits"; omit or pass "" to list all items).

intent.description: Optional buyer goal or use-case hint influencing relevance ranking.

address_region.description: Optional state, province, or subdivision code (e.g. "MD").

postal_code.description: Optional postal or ZIP code string.

currency.description: Preferred ISO 4217 currency code (storefront prices settle in "USD").

context.description: Optional buyer locality and intent signals.

available.description: When true (default), exclude out-of-stock variants; pass false to inspect unavailable items.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units (USD cents, e.g. 500 = $5.00).

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units (USD cents, e.g. 5000 = $50.00).

ships_to.description: Optional destination country filter (all digital items deliver globally).

filters.description: Hard exclusion filters applied to catalog items.

view.description: Optional server-side view hint such as "offer".

limit.description: Maximum products per page (1 to 50; defaults to 20).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous search_catalog response.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description:
Batch-resolve and refresh live USD pricing and stock for up to 50 known product, variant, or drop IDs. Use this to re-price saved wishlists or carts; do not use for keyword search (search_catalog) or single-product option pickers (get_product).
Parameters: pass catalog.ids (1-50 IDs or URLs), optional catalog.filters.available (default true; pass false to surface out-of-stock variants), and catalog.context.
Behavior: read-only, zero charge; groups matched variants by product and reports unknown IDs in messages[].

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Fetch full Product Detail Page (PDP) metadata, feature bullets, media, and variant availability for one product or variant ID. Use this before cart creation when inspecting a single item; do not use for multi-ID refresh (lookup_catalog) or keyword search (search_catalog).
Parameters: pass catalog.id (product URN, variant ID, or drop ID) plus optional catalog.selected, catalog.preferences, and catalog.context.
Behavior: read-only, zero charge; returns singular product object or a structured PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND error.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description:
Create a stateful UCP shopping cart with itemized USD cent totals and instant digital delivery estimates. Use this for low-commitment basket assembly; use create_checkout directly when ready to finalize purchase.
Parameters: pass cart.line_items (array of { item: { id }, quantity }), optional cart.context, and optional cart.buyer.
Behavior: allocates a ucart_* session valid for 2 hours, validates variant stock, and returns subtotal/total in USD cents plus continue_url.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description:
Retrieve current line items, itemized USD cent totals, expiration timestamp, and resume URL for an existing UCP cart. Use this to inspect ucart_* basket state; do not use for checkout sessions (get_checkout).
Parameters: pass top-level id ("ucart_<20 hex chars>") returned by create_cart.
Behavior: read-only, zero charge; returns current cart state or CART_NOT_FOUND when expired or unknown.

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description:
Replace line items or buyer locality context on an active ucart_* shopping cart and recompute USD cent totals. Use this to adjust quantities or add/remove variants before converting to checkout; do not use on canceled carts.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("ucart_*") and cart.line_items (full-replace list preserving line_items[].id for existing lines and item.id for variants) plus optional cart.context and cart.buyer.
Behavior: idempotent full-state replacement on active carts; rejects canceled or expired carts.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description:
Cancel and discard an active ucart_* shopping cart session so it can no longer be modified or converted into a checkout. Use this when a buyer abandons a basket; use cancel_checkout for uchk_* checkout sessions.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("ucart_*") and meta.idempotency-key.
Behavior: transitions cart status to "canceled" with replay-safe idempotency caching; zero financial charge.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description:
Create a uchk_* UCP checkout session either by converting an existing ucart_* cart or directly from buy-now line_items. Use this when transitioning from browsing/cart to purchase commitment; call complete_checkout next to generate the final payment handoff.
Parameters: pass checkout.cart_id (with checkout.line_items: []) to convert a cart, or pass non-empty checkout.line_items plus optional checkout.buyer and checkout.context.
Behavior: locks pre-completion USD cent totals, attaches instant digital fulfillment options, and returns uchk_* session state.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description:
Fetch current status, line items, final USD cent totals, fulfillment options, escalation messages, and continue_url for a uchk_* checkout session. Use this to poll or resume checkout state; use get_order for post-checkout order tracking.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_<20 hex chars>") returned by create_checkout.
Behavior: read-only, zero charge; returns current checkout status ("incomplete", "requires_escalation", "completed", or "canceled").

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description:
Finalize pre-payment checkout validation, mint a live Stripe Checkout or 50/50 Base DropERC1155 checkout session, and return UCP status "requires_escalation" with continue_url. Use this to hand the buyer off to Merchant-of-Record payment authorization.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_*"), meta.idempotency-key, and optional checkout.buyer or payment preferences.
Behavior: replay-safe on idempotency-key; never fabricates settled orders—returns requires_escalation + continue_url and records a trackable uord_* / Stripe order reference.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description:
Abort an open uchk_* UCP checkout session before payment settlement. Use this when the buyer declines or restarts checkout; cannot reverse an already-paid Stripe or on-chain Base USDC transaction.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uchk_*") and meta.idempotency-key.
Behavior: transitions checkout status to "canceled" with idempotency replay protection and zero charge.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description:
Inspect post-checkout payment and fulfillment status for a Quantum Atlas UCP order ID (uord_*), uchk_* checkout ID, or 32-hex Stripe spend-pack order ID. Use this after buyer handoff to check whether payment completed.
Parameters: pass top-level id ("uord_*", "uchk_*", or 32-hex Stripe card order ID).
Behavior: read-only, zero charge; queries live Stripe card order and 50/50 settlement state, reporting truthful "awaiting_buyer_payment" or "completed" status.
